description: Set a specific organization membership as the default for a user in Zendesk. Use when you need to change which organization is the primary/default for a user. Only one organization can be the default at a time. This action is idempotent - setting the same membership as default multiple times will succeed without side effects.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for making an organization membership the default for a user.

organization_membership_id.description: The numeric ID of the organization membership to set as the user's default. Obtain from zendesk.get_userS_ORGANIZATION_MEMBERSHIPS; do not guess or fabricate IDs.
organization_membership_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the numeric ID of the organization membership to make default for the user. You can find this ID by listing the user's organization memberships.
organization_membership_id.title: Organization Membership Id

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk user whose organization membership you want to set as default. Obtain from ZENDESK_LIST_USERS or ZENDESK_SEARCH_USERS; do not guess or fabricate IDs.
user_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the numeric ID of the user whose default organization membership should be changed. You can find user IDs by listing or searching users in Zendesk.
user_id.title: User Id
